sn2.20:1.1: Anāthapiṇḍiko. Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.20:2.1: Idaṃ hitaṃ Jetavanaṃ || isisaṅghanisevitaṃ || āvuttham dhammarājena || pītisaṃjananaṃ mama || ||
sn2.20:3.1: Kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca || sīlam jīvitam uttamaṃ || etena maccā sujjhanti || na gottena dhanena vā || ||
sn2.20:4.1: Tasmā hi paṇḍito poso || sampassaṃ attham attano || yoniso vicine dhammaṃ || evaṃ tattha visujjhati || ||
sn2.20:5.1: Sāriputto va paññāya || sīlen-upasamena ca || yo pi pāraṅgato bhikkhu || etāva paramo siyā ti || ||
sn2.20:6.1: Idam avoca Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto || idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-eva antaradhāyi || ||
sn2.20:7.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi || || Imam bhikkhave rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yenāham ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave so devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.20:8.1: Idaṃ hitaṃ Jetavanaṃ || isisaṅghanissevitaṃ || āvutthaṃ dhammarājena || pītisaṃjananaṃ mama || ||
sn2.20:9.1: kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca || sīlaṃ jīvitam uttamaṃ || etena maccā sujjhanti || na gottena dhanena vā || ||
sn2.20:10.1: Tasmā hi paṇḍito poso || sampassam attham attano || yoniso vicine dhammaṃ || evaṃ tattha visujjhati || ||
sn2.20:11.1: Sāriputto va paññāya || sīlen-upasamena ca || yo pi pāraṅgato bhikkhu etāva paramo siyā ti || ||
sn2.20:12.1: Idam avoca bhikkhave so devaputto || idam vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
sn2.20:13.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || || So hi nūna bhante Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati || Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmante Sāriputte abhippasanno ahosīti || || Sādhu sādhu Ānanda || yāvatakaṃ kho Ānanda takkāya pattabbaṃ anuppattaṃ tayā || Anāthapiṇḍiko hi so Ānanda devaputto ti || || Anāthapiṇḍika-vaggo dutiyo || ||
sn2.20:14.0: Tass-uddānaṃ || || Candimāso ca Veṇḍu ca || Dīghalaṭṭhi ca Nandano || Candano ca Sudatto ca || Subrahmā || Kakudhena ca || Uttaro navamo vutto || dasamo Anāthapiṇḍiko ti || || ___________________________________________
